exposure: Full-term birth (gestational age 39 and 0/7 weeks to 40 and 6/7 weeks)
Early-term birth (gestational age 37 and 0/7 weeks to 38 and 6/7 weeks)
cohort: 356 neonates born from January 2021-June 2022, excluding those with specific conditions.
finding: Early-term neonates have a greater risk of developing jaundice and requiring phototherapy than full-term neonates.
